_comment: Verification scope for the iridex profile repo. No application, so 'works' proves the page is intact and every brand-asset CDN URL it embeds actually resolves - a broken asset would otherwise render as a broken image on a public identity page with nothing in the repo to reveal it. CI also runs weekly on a schedule for that reason: the failure originates outside this repo, so a push-only trigger would never catch it. See B:/runners/verify.ps1 and canon disclosure_and_verification.md 2.3.
memory: n/a - a user profile README validated by scripts/verify_profile.py. The verification here is a one-shot script that runs and exits, so there is no resident process for a leak to accumulate in. Re-declare this the moment anything here becomes long-running.
